Q: Android Automotive: Could not identify launch activity: Default Activity not found A:

TLDR:

Go to your Automotive module configuration -> Launch Options -> Nothing.

Per current documentation, an Android Automotive OS app do not use the MAIN intent nor LAUNCHER intent. Only settings and sign-in activity are allowed.

Source: https://stackoverflow.com/a/62186376/1137814

Q: Get Spacemacs/Emacs GUI version to recognize nix-shell environment A:

You can run your GUI Emacs as

setsid nix-shell . --command "emacs" &> /dev/null

Also see discussion about nix-shell integration to flycheck and ghc-mode.

Tip: you can use alias for this in your .zshrc or .bashrc

run-nix-emacs () {
  setsid nix-shell . --command "emacs" &> /dev/null
}

alias ne='run-nix-emacs'

UPD: direnv + direnv-mode (+ optionally nix-direnv to speed-up) works like a charm with no additional hacks. Also consider using nix flakes, which are way more ergonomic.
